facebook.content:
The Kingdom’s economy is not “what I earn,” it’s “what He gives.” When we count our worth by salary or savings, we miss the promise of Philippians 4:19—“He will meet all your needs according to the riches of His glory.” Your identity shifts from self‑sustaining to God‑sustaining the moment you claim His provision as your source.  

What need will you release to God today, trusting He will supply it?

Your identity isn’t what the world labels you—it’s the royalty stamped on you by God. Heb 1:3 declares Christ “the exact representation of His being.” As His likeness, you inherit the throne of grace. 

If you walked each day aware that the King has already crowned you, how would that change the decisions you make right now?
